text:
Harper: Mocha Labs wants a 4-week POC for their Mocha-QLoRA-30B variant. Main asks: custom tokenizer (nonstandard merges), 4-bit qlora, embeddings for a reranker, KMS + VPC peering, and committed-per-call pricing for the trial.
Diego: Catalog check: we have mocha-30b-base but no qlora variant and no tokenizer. Ask for tokenizer.json + merges and a 300-line sample corpus. Without that we can't validate kv-cache alignment.
Rina: On embeddings: they want 2048-d. We can project from 1024 -> 2048 with a lightweight adapter for POC, but call latency will increase ~10-15%. Need to know their reranker type (dot/cosine) and normalization needs.
Samir: Quant note: our 4-bit execution path supports qlora weights, but p95 increases with long context and certain attention patterns. Recommend perf runs at seq=1024/2048 and a fallback plan to fp16.
Harper: Action items: 1) Request tokenizer artifacts + sample prompts. 2) Ask for expected peak & avg RPS and token/day. 3) Run perf 4-bit vs fp16 once artifacts arrive. 4) Fill security QS and confirm PHI presence.
Diego: I ran a baseline on mocha-30b-base (no tokenizer yet) for ballpark: ```bash
redwood perf --model mocha-30b-base --quant 4bit --seq 1024 --batch 4
# p50: 95ms/token
# p95: 380ms/token
redwood perf --model mocha-30b-base --quant fp16 --seq 1024 --batch 4
# p50: 78ms/token
# p95: 240ms/token
``` Logs uploaded to RW-33100. Expect ~10-25% tail when qlora applies.
Rina: For embeddings projector I'll prepare a tiny example (1024->2048) and a quick eval harness to surface similarity delta. Will attach sample metrics.
Samir: Pricing pointer: hosted PAYG estimate ~ $0.013 / 1k gen tokens for this size; 2-GPU dedicated pool estimate ~$5k/mo committed. For a 4-week POC we can offer a temporary committed discount + X free burst tokens. Need token/day to finalize.
Harper: Security ops: they requested KMS + VPC peering and longer log retention (180 days). 180 days requires enterprise addendum and SLA change. If PHI is present recommend Private deployment and BAA.
Diego: Also flag tokenizer special tokens: if IDs shift >8 positions we must run a token-id-diff and potentially insert a small remap adapter to keep kv-cache stable. I can script that.
Rina: If they accept projected embeddings, embed compute will add ~12% latency to generation calls. Will include numbers in the POC doc.
redwood-deploy-bot: Ticket RW-33100 created and assigned to #sales, #eng-ml, #eng-security.
Harper: Proposed POC timeline to Mocha: week 0 artifacts + security QS; week 1 tokenization validation + embed sanity; week 2 perf runs + pricing; week 3 integration + security sign-off; week 4 handoff + decision. Sending now.
Samir: I'll draft a 3-option pricing sheet (hosted PAYG, 4-week committed pool, private POC) and include example math for 50k / 500k tokens.
Diego: Once tokenizer arrives I'll run token-id diff and perf with their tokenizer and paste results. If needed I'll stub a remap adapter.
Harper: Thanks team. I'll collect artifacts and QS and loop back when they reply :thumbsup:
